assertions.text: Review names Cynefin domain as Complex (or notes multiple emergent dimensions)
assertions.evidence: 'Cynefin domain: Complex. Three themes ... all sit in the emergent / behavioural-feedback space.'

assertions.text: Review selects Full tier (quarter-long appetite, multiple themes)
assertions.evidence: 'Tier: Full — selected because appetite >1 week AND ≥3 implicit dependencies ... allocation decision itself is a one-way door for the quarter'

assertions.text: B1 (problem framing) verdict is SUSTAINED or PARTIAL — themes named without measurable outcomes
assertions.evidence: 'B1 — Problem framing. Verdict: SUSTAINED. ... There is no measurable outcome attached to any theme.'

assertions.text: B2 (scope) verdict is SUSTAINED — at least one theme has scope-vague concern (no triage record cited)
assertions.evidence: 'No idea-triage record cited for any theme | SUSTAINED' and multiple per-theme SUSTAINED scope items in B2 table.

assertions.text: B3 (assumptions) verdict is SUSTAINED — at least one assumption flagged as low-confidence/anecdotal
assertions.evidence: '"Users want a shareable shortlist" (because we keep getting requests) | 0.5 — anecdote ... | SUSTAINED'

assertions.text: B3 includes a numeric confidence score (Gilad Confidence Meter, 0.1–10) on at least one assumption
assertions.evidence: 'Confidence (Gilad)' column with values 0.5, 0.1, 0.1, 0.1, 0.1 on five assumptions.

assertions.text: Review recommends running idea-triage on themes before allocation
assertions.evidence: 'Run `idea-triage` on each of the three themes before allocation is locked.'

assertions.text: At least one bucket has a named falsifying condition (concrete check that would overturn the verdict)
assertions.evidence: B1: 'Falsifying condition: Owner produces, for each theme, a Rule-A2 problem statement with a named target metric and target delta within 24 hours.' Plus B2 table 'Falsifying condition' column with concrete checks per row.
